label: Higher at D2 on reaching S1 and when belief favors S1; higher after unrewarded trials.
terms: (phase == D2) * (state == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 0) * (prev_state == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase != D2) * (prev_reward == 0) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == D2) * (state == 1) * (ep_trial > 79)
explanation: Raw reset gate of unit 11 (timing explains R^2 0.85; it is highest at GO). Beyond timing: at D2 it rises when the reached state is S1 (strongest after a1->S1) and grows with the ideal-observer log-odds that S1 is good; at D1 and GO it rises after an unrewarded trial (most at D1 after an unrewarded S1 visit), building up over consecutive unrewarded trials. The choice itself adds little at D2 once state and belief are in. The free fit adds a GO belief term, the S1-specific D1 no-reward bump, a two-unrewarded-in-a-row term and a late-episode boost of the D2 S1 effect. No future variables used.

issues: The label leaves out phases: belief only enters at D2 (making the belief term apply at GO as well drops test R^2 0.637 to 0.626; a non-D2 belief term instead of the reward term gives 0.560), and the no-reward boost only holds at D1/GO. The label should name these phases.

Each term matters on test: dropping state gives 0.499, dropping D2 belief gives 0.371, dropping the D1/GO no-reward term gives 0.526. Swapping state for choice (action==1) at D2 gives 0.499, and adding choice to state+belief adds nothing (0.5256 either way). So the claim that the choice adds little at D2 holds, and so does 'most after a1->S1' (D2 residual +0.119).
The no-reward term should not be phase-agnostic or D1-only: the phase-agnostic version gives 0.555, D1 only 0.600, GO only 0.550.

Systematic misses remain. GO after a2 S1 u is over-predicted by -0.080: the residual there is negative (-0.054) even though the trial was unrewarded, so 'higher after unrewarded trials' fails for rare-unrewarded a2->S1 at GO. D2 after a2 S2 u (-0.064) and a2 S1 r (-0.052) are over-predicted. D1 after unrewarded S1 visits is under-predicted (+0.039). The worst windows are late in the episode (t86-99), with consecutive unrewarded trials building up beyond what is predicted.

Simple fixes for these did not help on test: a two-unrewarded-in-a-row term 0.637, excluding a2 S1 u 0.636, a late-episode-gated term 0.543, an ep_trial ramp 0.617. The short form stays the best simple description I found (observed-only ceiling 0.87).
